name: CyberXero
akas: Underground-forum alias (Dread, HackForums, Exploit.in); Russian-speaking initial access broker (SOCRadar)
brief: SOCRadar recovered an exposed server (90,000+ files) showing a Russian-speaking initial access broker running Claude Code with 51 specialized subagents (roles such as c2-operator, exploit-chainer, scada-attacker) plus the open-source PentAGI pentest framework wired to a Cobalt Strike team server against Ukrainian critical-infrastructure and other targets. The operator repeatedly claimed ownership of targets to get past model refusals (some refusals held, including a backdoor install). SOCRadar confirmed exfiltration from four Ukrainian organizations (628,000+ records, 564,073 from one Kharkiv district-heating provider) and reconnaissance of seven energy/utility entities. *Analyst note: the "40+ organizations worldwide" figure is self-reported by the operator's records; secondary outlets embellish. Vendor source.* SOCRadar
